steps.name: host_file_readable_in_container
steps.detail: cat /data/hello.txt -> from-host

steps.name: bind_owned_by_container_root_at_start
steps.detail: 5 of 5 containers saw the bind owned by 0:0 and could chmod it in their first command

steps.name: bind_owned_by_container_user_at_start
steps.detail: a container running as 1000:1000 saw the bind owned by 1000:1000 and could chmod it at once

steps.name: plain_runc_shows_the_fault
steps.detail: with --runtime runc (no refresh) the first look saw 65534:65534 chmod: /data: Operation not permitted : the checks above can fail

steps.name: ownership_mapped_to_root_in_guest
steps.detail: host 501:20 appears as 0:0 in the container (the sharing user owns the share; containers see root)

steps.name: container_write_owned_by_host_user
steps.detail: container wrote c.txt, chmod 640 kept, chown 1000:1000 ignored; host sees 501:20 640, guest sees 0:0 640

steps.name: readonly_share_enforced
steps.detail: read-only content sh: can't create /ro/y.txt: Read-only file system

steps.name: docker_ro_flag_enforced
steps.detail: sh: can't create /data/z.txt: Read-only file system

steps.name: host_edit_visible_promptly
steps.detail: host wrote p.txt and the next container read saw it

steps.name: replayed_file_owned_by_container_root
steps.detail: 5 replayed host edits: each event handler saw owner 0 and could chmod at once (0 chmod-ok;0 chmod-ok;0 chmod-ok;0 chmod-ok;0 chmod-ok;)

steps.name: inotify_guest_writes_seen
steps.detail: events: n /data from-guest.txt;c /data from-guest.txt;w /data from-guest.txt;c /data from-guest.txt;c /data owned.txt;c /data owned.txt;c /data owned.txt;c /data owned.txt;c /data owned.txt;

steps.name: inotify_host_edit_propagated
steps.detail: host append to hello.txt reached the container as an inotify event after 76 ms (polled)

steps.name: inotify_host_create_propagated
steps.detail: host create of from-host.txt reached the container as an inotify event (IN_MODIFY, not IN_CREATE) after 66 ms (polled)

steps.name: inotify_host_mtime_preserved
steps.detail: the replay left hello.txt's contents and mtime (1794873199.115123869) unchanged; only the host ctime moves

steps.name: inotify_no_echo_storm
steps.detail: one host edit produced 1 event(s) for hello.txt in 5 s; the replay's own FSEvents echo is dropped

steps.name: inotify_ro_share_host_edits_not_propagated
steps.detail: host edits on a read-only share produce no inotify events (the guest cannot touch files there; documented residual, TD-038)

steps.name: inotify_host_delete_seen_on_parent
steps.detail: host delete of sub/d.txt reached the container as a change of the directory sub (IN_MODIFY on the parent, not IN_DELETE)

steps.name: inotify_host_rename_seen
steps.detail: host rename sub/e.txt -> sub/f.txt reached the container as a change of sub and an event for f.txt (no IN_MOVED_FROM/TO)

steps.name: inotify_share_root_delete_not_propagated
steps.detail: a host delete directly in the share's root directory produces no event (the guest cannot touch a share root; documented residual, TD-038)

steps.name: inotify_burst_delivered
steps.detail: 500 files created on the host in one burst: events for all 500 within 1260 ms (polled); System VM healthy

steps.name: inotify_nowatch_share_silent
steps.detail: host edits on the read-write share mounted with :nowatch produce no inotify events (opt-out honoured)

steps.name: inotify_host_rapid_edits_mtime_preserved
steps.detail: 200 host appends to one file, 25 ms apart, while a container stat-ed it in a loop: after each of 5 rounds the host mtime (ns) equalled the last host write and all 201 lines were intact

steps.name: unshared_path_is_refused
steps.detail: -v /tmp/vesper-not-shared is refused; only configured shares map host paths, and no directory is made in the System VM (path policy)
